dict.string: Soundrift needs microphone access to change the system default input device.
Soundrift uses Bluetooth to recognize paired headphones (AirPods, Beats, and similar) so it can show the correct device icon. It does not scan for or connect to devices.
Soundrift uses Bluetooth to recognize paired headphones (AirPods, Beats, and similar) so it can show the correct device icon. It does not scan for or connect to devices.
Soundrift looks on your local network to show the real name of AirPlay devices (for example your Apple TV) instead of the generic “AirPlay” label.
